summary: Implemented rich.progress open and wrap_file (module-level and Progress methods) with private _Reader, _ReaderContext, and _make_file_progress helpers in rich/progress.py; added 22 tests in tests/test_progress.py before the __main__ block; added "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections to docs/source/progress.rst; added one Unreleased/Added bullet in CHANGELOG.md linking PR 1759. Changes are additive and uncommitted. Nothing was run per instructions, so the test suite, mypy (including whether all listed type-ignore suppressions are needed), and the Python 3.6.2 import check are unverified. Choices to review: module-level open takes mode as Any in its implementation; the reader defines mode, name, and truncate (truncate raises UnsupportedOperation) because typing.BinaryIO declares them abstract; if entering the context fails, the display is stopped and the reader is closed before re-raising.
